drafts.text:
HOOK
Big volatility is heading to the dollar and stocks this morning.
[ON SCREEN: Fast-moving US Dollar Index chart]

WHAT IT IS
The US Unemployment Rate for Nov drops at 08:30 ET. Markets expect 4.1%, unchanged from 4.1%.
[ON SCREEN: Text "US Unemployment: Forecast 4.1% vs Previous 4.1%"]

WHY IT MATTERS
The Federal Reserve is watching the labor market closely to steer interest rates. That makes this print critical for the US Dollar Index, EUR/USD, and the S&P 500.
[ON SCREEN: Split screen showing EUR/USD and S&P 500 tickers]

WHAT TO WATCH
If unemployment prints above 4.1%, it signals cooling employment conditions. That could weigh on the greenback and lift equity sentiment on rate-cut bets. But if the rate drops below 4.1%, showing unexpected labor resilience, traders will watch for dollar strength and renewed pressure across major equities.
[ON SCREEN: "Above 4.1% = Dollar pressure / Below 4.1% = Dollar strength"]

CLOSE
For live reaction and daily setups, get the full breakdown on FXEmpire.
[ON SCREEN: FXEmpire logo and website URL]

drafts.text:
HOOK
German inflation is back, and European markets could see an immediate reaction.
[ON SCREEN: EUR/USD and DAX price tickers]
WHAT IT IS
Germany reports preliminary annual inflation for Nov at 08:00 ET. Consensus is looking for 3.0%, up from 2.8% last month.
[ON SCREEN: Forecast 3.0% vs Previous 2.8%]
WHY IT MATTERS
Germany is Europe's economic powerhouse, so this release shapes European Central Bank policy expectations. That makes it a major mover for both EUR/USD and the DAX. Rising inflation pressures the central bank to stay tight, which directly impacts currency strength and equity valuations.
[ON SCREEN: ECB building and DAX chart]
WHAT TO WATCH
If the data beats 3.0%, the euro could see quick upside as rate bets firm up. A print below expectations could relieve pressure and lift the DAX.
[ON SCREEN: Hotter CPI vs Cooler CPI scenarios]
CLOSE
You can find the full breakdown and live coverage on FXEmpire.
[ON SCREEN: FXEmpire logo]

drafts.text:
HOOK
Euro traders, get ready for a major volatility spike this morning.
[ON SCREEN: Tiger to camera with EUR/USD ticker]
WHAT IT IS
The Euro Area Flash Inflation report for Nov drops at 05:00 ET. The consensus forecast is 3.9%, compared to 4% previously.
[ON SCREEN: "Forecast: 3.9% | Previous: 4%"]
WHY IT MATTERS
Inflation remains the primary catalyst for European Central Bank policy. Persistent price pressures could force policymakers to maintain tight conditions, directly moving EUR/USD and European equities like the DAX index.
[ON SCREEN: EUR/USD and DAX split chart]
WHAT TO WATCH
Watch for surprises against expectations. A hotter print could boost EUR/USD as traders price in firmer interest rates, while potentially weighing on the DAX. Conversely, a cooler reading could pressure the single currency and lift equities.
[ON SCREEN: Hot vs Cool reaction graphic]
CLOSE
Check out the full breakdown and market analysis on FXEmpire.
[ON SCREEN: FXEmpire logo]
